## Problem and intended change

Describe the concrete knowledge defect, question or feature.

## Evidence and rationale

Identify directly supporting sources, limitations and authored inference. Distinguish selected KPS conventions from externally established facts.

## Files and compatibility

List changed knowledge roles/Practice stages and any links, dependency summaries or language-compatibility impact.

## Checks

- [ ] Reviewed `AUTHORING.md`
- [ ] Knowledge remains locally understandable/executable
- [ ] `python validate.py .` passed (or failure explained)
- [ ] `python test_validate.py` passed (or failure explained)
- [ ] No third-party copyrighted full text or private data included
